scope: knowledge-explainer and news-brief: domain standards first, object-is-explanation, layered reveal, truth ledger
notes: These are review prompts with expected behaviour. They have not been run against any model; no pass rate is claimed.
Each case is judged by reading the produced plan, knowledge pack and answer. The scripts only check structure and wording, never truth or comprehension.

evals.prompt: 做一个90秒视频，给没学过网络的人讲清TCP三次握手。
evals.expected_output: A plan with a knowledge pack that registers RFC 9293 with a status, one term per meaning, an object carrier with a one-to-one part mapping and breaks_at, every number in the truth ledger, layers climbing from L0 to L6, and an L6 that names what is not shown.

assertions.standard_status_honest: verified only if the clause was actually read; otherwise seed with a warning
assertions.carrier_ladder: starts at a real object or process; falls back with a reason, never a decorative metaphor
must_not: three arrows and three labels presented as the whole explanation

evals.prompt: 用视频解释“为什么做事要先想清楚再动手”。
evals.expected_output: The answer states that no honest mechanism carrier exists for this opinion, records carrier kind none or a diagram with a reason and a fallback, and does not invent a machine to fit the idea.

assertions.standards: kind none with a reason, not an invented standard

evals.prompt: 把这则公告做成45秒资讯视频：北辰区图书馆（虚构）自11月1日起，周末闭馆时间由17点改为19点，公告没有说法定节假日是否适用。
evals.expected_output: An evidence-board plan: relation_type event, every sourced fact carries a source and as_of date, the extension of 2 hours is a derived claim, the holiday question is an unconfirmed slot, and the film is labelled fictional if the source is fictional.

assertions.derived_claim: 19 minus 17 equals 2 hours, traced to its two sourced claims

evals.prompt: 旁白稿里有“大概”“基本上”和一句四十多个字的长句，帮我改到能直接配音。
evals.expected_output: The lint output is read first; vague words are replaced by the real figure or a plain statement, the long sentence is split so each sentence carries one idea, terms stay consistent, and letters or abbreviations get a spoken form.

evals.prompt: 把已经做好的讲解里的序号 100 改成 200。
evals.expected_output: The truth ledger is changed first; every derived claim and every line of narration, caption and dial that depends on it is found and changed; the pack and plan are validated again; earlier passed checks are reset to not_run.

evals.prompt: 讲清一个很小众的行业概念，我不确定有没有行业标准。
evals.expected_output: The agent searches for standards and consensus, records what it found with a status, writes kind none or not_found with a reason when nothing usable exists, and does not make up a standard number.

evals.prompt: 做一个8分钟的课程视频，讲清分布式一致性。
evals.expected_output: The long film is cut into chapters; each chapter repeats the climb with a bridge from the last; one new load per layer; a recap and a self-check at each chapter end; extension pointers and a model boundary at the close.

must_not: one continuous climb that adds several new things in a single layer
sections renamed as layers with no new load rule

evals.prompt: 这套方法能让观众理解提升多少？
evals.expected_output: The answer states that no audience test has been run, gives no percentage, and proposes how to test: novice, peer and expert readings plus a recall question.

must_not: claiming the Skill was validated on viewers

evals.prompt: 讲清楚一个机械原理，但我不想要爆炸图，只想要简单一点的画面。
evals.expected_output: The plan keeps the one-to-one mapping and one lit focus, uses a simpler carrier or a diagram if that is the honest choice, and does not draw leader lines, balloons or floating labels.

must_not: all parts flying out at once
